description: Scripted multi-turn conversations for the Phase 6 agent. Written by hand OUTSIDE the golden set and before any evaluation run (docs/DECISIONS-phase6.md, A15); they are not golden items and never feed a golden metric. Each turn says what the customer types and what must be true afterwards. {order:NNN} and {email:NNN} are the number and the owner's email of the seed order shopmate-seed-order-NNN (data/seed/orders.vi.json); TEMPLATE:NAME is a fixed reply of app/agent/templates.py. The expectations are the bounds of docs/AGENT-DESIGN.md section 3 and what they must never allow.
